node.statement: Factorization bound: let P be an exact signed idempotent (square real matrix with P^2 = P and all row sums equal to 1), let delta(P) = max_i sum_j max(-P_ij, 0), let k = rank(P), and let U = (u_1, ..., u_k) be an actual-row basis of P (the rows p_{u_1}, ..., p_{u_k} of P form a basis of the row space of P) whose Gram volume satisfies Vol(U) >= (1/2) * Vol_max(P), where Vol_max(P) is the maximum Gram volume over all actual-row bases of P; define coordinates a_t(j) by p_j = sum_t a_t(j) p_{u_t}, and for each pivot index s in {1, ..., k} set beta_s(j) = P_{u_s j}, lambda_s(j) = 1 - a_s(j), mu_s(j) = sum_{t != s} max(-a_t(j), 0), sigma_s(j) = sum_{t != s} max(a_t(j), 0), E_s(j) = max(mu_s(j) - lambda_s(j), 0), Phi_s(U) = sum_j max(beta_s(j), 0) * E_s(j), and S*_s(U) = sum_j max(beta_s(j), 0) * (sigma_s(j) + 2 * max(-lambda_s(j), 0)); then for every pivot s, S*_s(U) <= 2 * Phi_s(U) + 6 * delta(P).
